title: Staging app monitoring
description: RED metrics, dependencies, pods and logs for the staging API and race API. Panels use Prometheus metrics; Loki is only queried from the collapsed Logs row.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests served in the selected range, excluding health probes.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Average request rate over the selected range.

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Server errors as a share of all requests in the range.

panels.title: 4xx share
panels.description: Client errors (auth, validation, not found) as a share of all requests.

panels.title: p50
panels.description: Median latency over the range.

panels.title: p95
panels.description: 95th percentile latency over the range.

panels.title: Pods ready
panels.description: Available replicas as a share of desired replicas, right now.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts (crashes, OOM kills, failed probes) in the range.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Request rate split by HTTP status class.

panels.title: Error share
panels.description: Share of requests answered with 4xx or 5xx.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Server-side request duration across all routes (histogram buckets up to 10 s).

panels.title: p95 by route (slowest 10)
panels.description: 95th percentile latency of the ten slowest routes at each point.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_target) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job="$app", http_target=~"$route", http_target!~"/(livez|readyz|healthz|metrics)"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Routes in selected range
panels.description: Per-route totals for the selected range. Sort by any column.

targets.expr: (sum by (http_target) (rate({__name__="http_server_duration_milliseconds_count", job="$app", http_target=~"$route", http_target!~"/(livez|readyz|healthz|metrics)", http_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (http_target) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job="$app", http_target=~"$route", http_target!~"/(livez|readyz|healthz|metrics)"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (http_target) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job="$app", http_target=~"$route", http_target!~"/(livez|readyz|healthz|metrics)"}[$__range])) * 100

sum by (http_target) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_sum{job="$app", http_target=~"$route", http_target!~"/(livez|readyz|healthz|metrics)"}[$__range])) / sum by (http_target) (rate(http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job="$app", http_target=~"$route", http_target!~"/(livez|readyz|healthz|metrics)"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Dependency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of calls to Postgres, Redis, Keycloak, Stripe and JWKS.

panels.title: Dependency errors / s
panels.description: Failed dependency calls per second.

panels.title: DB pool usage
panels.description: SQLAlchemy connections in use across pods versus pool capacity. Sustained use near capacity means requests are queueing for a connection.

panels.title: CPU per pod
panels.description: CPU used by each pod against the container limit.

panels.title: Memory per pod
panels.description: Working-set memory per pod; the kernel OOM-kills at the dashed limit.

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of CPU periods in which the pod was throttled. High values add latency.

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: Warning and error log lines per interval (line filter, no JSON parsing).

panels.title: Recent errors
panels.description: Latest 100 error lines. Open in Explore for more.
